FCP.Ranks.RankTrackDef.label: NCR Ranks
FCP.Ranks.RankTrackDef.drillDesc: Drill with any colonist. Both stop, stand apart, and draw their weapons for the session. Both gain skill XP. Once per day.
FCP.Ranks.RankTrackDef.inspectDesc: Inspect a lower-ranked soldier's weapon and armor condition. A clean kit earns a commendation, a dirty one earns a reprimand.
FCP.Ranks.RankTrackDef.punishDesc: Assign a lower-ranked soldier a stretch of latrine duty for a discipline lapse, souring their mood. Once per day per soldier.
FCP.Ranks.RankTrackDef.rallyDesc: Rally every combat-ranked member of {0} on this map with a burst of speed and combat effectiveness. Once every few days.
FCP.Ranks.RankTrackDef.fallInDesc: Order {0} to fall in behind you in ranks, up to four deep, interrupting whatever they're doing. They'll hold formation until dismissed.
FCP.Ranks.RankTrackDef.dismissDesc: Dismiss {0} from formation, letting them return to duty.
